title: &aStone and Ore
subtitle: Vein mining, crystal caves and every ore the pack adds.

quests.title: Vein Mining
quests.subtitle: FTB Ultimine
desc: Hold &e`&r (the key left of 1) while you break a block: &eFTB Ultimine&r breaks up to &e64&r connected blocks of the same kind. Whole ore veins, whole trees.
Scroll the mouse wheel while holding the key to change the shape (a tunnel, a flat square...). Every block costs hunger, so bring food.

quests.title: Ores of the Machine Age
desc: &eMekanism&r adds osmium, tin, lead, uranium and fluorite ores. &eOsmium&r goes into nearly every Mekanism machine, tin and copper make bronze, and lead shields you from radiation.
The Mekanism chapter shows how to turn one ore into two, three, then five ingots.

quests.title: Zinc for Create
desc: &eZinc&r ore lies in stone and deepslate. Zinc and copper make &ebrass&r, Create's middle-tier metal, which you need for precision mechanisms and the Lantern Power Core.
Crush it with Create's crushing wheels for extra yield.

quests.title: Gems of the Wild
desc: &eIce and Fire&r adds &esapphire&r in cold mountains and &esilver&r underground. Silver weapons hurt the undead more. &eKings & Monsters&r adds &eBog Iron&r in swamps.
Apotheosis gems aren't mined: they drop from monsters and chests (see the Apotheosis chapter).

quests.title: Crystal Canyons
quests.subtitle: Galosphere
desc: &eGalosphere&r adds three cave biomes: &dCrystal Canyons&r (huge crystal clusters), &aLichen Caves&r and &dPink Salt Caves&r.
They lie deep underground. A title shows on screen when you walk into one.

quests.title: Allurite and Lumiere
desc: &9Allurite&r and &eLumiere&r crystals grow beside amethyst in the canyons. Mine the shards for lamps and building blocks.
Mages want them too: Galosphere Spellbooks uses them for the Allurite Pendant and Sterling gear.

quests.title: Palladium and Sterling
desc: Galosphere's &epalladium&r ore smelts into ingots for &eSterling&r armour and horse armour.
Pink salt caves are worth a visit too: salt preserves meat into jerky that lasts on long trips.

quests.title: Mithril, Deep Down
desc: &eMithril&r (Iron's Spells) is rare and hides deep in the deepslate layer. Ultimine helps once you find a vein.
Mages need it: mithril goes into every Empty Upgrade Orb and into Mithril Weave for the best school armour.

quests.title: Draconium
desc: &eDraconium&r ore appears deep in the Overworld, in the Nether and (richest of all) in the End. It drops dust that smelts into ingots.
It's the first step of Draconic Evolution, the pack's most powerful tech line.

quests.title: Sculk and Silence
desc: Far below the deepslate lie the &eAncient Cities&r, where the Warden listens for footsteps. Sneak, don't sprint, and avoid the shriekers.
Their chests hold rare books (mages look for Ruined Books here) and Echo Shards.

quests.title: Ancient Debris
desc: In the Nether, around height 15, &eAncient Debris&r hides in netherrack. It's slow to mine and only a diamond pickaxe or better breaks it, so bring fire resistance and watch for lava.
Netherite upgrades gear and appears in many late recipes: the Levitation Stone, battlemage robes, the best backpacks.

quests.title: Master of the Deep
desc: Every ore in the pack has passed through your hands. Not bad for someone who started with a wooden pickaxe.
Next: turn all that ore into machines (Create, Mekanism) or magic (Iron's Spells).
